global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with tender chashu pork slices and a single nori sheet. It sits in a white bowl with red geometric patterns, resting on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red geometric pattern and Chinese characters along its rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is amber-brown, bubbly, and rich, with visible noodles and green onions floating within its textured surface.
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed, irregularly shaped, with textured surface and visible white specks, appears slightly curled at edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, pale pink slices with glossy surface, slightly curled edges, and visible marbling.
